# ACME Corp Knowledge Catalog

> Central repository for domain definitions, business logic, and engineering standards formatted in Open Knowledge Format (OKF).

## Knowledge
- [ACME Master Catalog](https://github.io): The root entry point for all open knowledge bundles.
- [Change Ledger](https://github.io): A timeline of all additions, verification status changes, and deprecations.

## Guidelines
- All metadata blocks are written in strict YAML frontmatter.
- Paths are stable. Do not hallucinate URLs outside of the `/docs/` tree.
